steps.text: Follow these steps exactly, then stop. 1. Call the subagent tool once with run_in_background set to true, description 'Reply with CHILD_OK', and prompt 'Reply with exactly the word CHILD_OK and nothing else.'. 2. Collect its result with task_output using the task id from the acknowledgement and wait: true. 3. Call send_message with subagent_id exactly '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222' (a subagent that does not exist) and message 'Please continue.'. 4. Collect the task it started with task_output and wait: true, and observe that it failed. 5. Reply with the single word DONE. Do not use the bash tool.
